class.name: GrazePreviewLayer2D
class.brief_description: Internal graze ring preview layer owned by [BulletSpawner2D]. Not for direct use.
class.description: Internal helper behind the [BulletSpawner2D] graze preview and the [BulletFactory2D] runtime preview of zones flagged [member BulletGrazeZone2D.preview_during_runtime] (the "~BlastBulletsGrazePreview" child of the spawner, "~BlastBulletsGrazeRuntimePreview" of the factory). It draws every ring of every graze zone around each resolved target and repaints itself on every engine redraw. It is top-level (canvas coordinates), internal and owner-less: never saved to scenes, never listed by [method Node.get_children], never a pattern marker. At runtime the spawner's layer only exists when [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_preview_during_runtime] is on, the factory's only while a flagged zone is in use. Tune it through the spawner's Graze properties.
